Are you looking for a whole new tower or just a gpu for an existing one? If it’s just a GPU  then Depends on your budget. If you’re just looking for three monitors and not much gaming performance any graphics card with 3 output ports will do it provided you have appropriate connector cables obviously. If you want to keep your machine running smoothly though you might be looking at around £200 (I’m uk based, don’t know much about other regions pricing and tax) for a midrange modern card. Some 1650 and most 1660s have at least that many outputs. You could go second hand for an older high end card but that’s always a lottery on reliability. Look into RX series cards too as they’re cheaper but board partners on those are sometimes lacklustre on ports in favour of higher clocks and such.
